{{Short description|Polyhedral compound}}
The '''compound of six octahedra''' has two forms. One form is a symmetric arrangement of 6 [[octahedra]], considered as square bipyramid. It is a dual of a special case of the [[compound of six cubes with rotational freedom|compound of 6 cubes with rotational freedom]].

Another form is a dual of another [[compound of six cubes]].
